authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login real-data source window. Planning Data reports 364 local-plan boundaries; the dataset represents the area a local plan covers and exposes exact boundary references plus Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry. A bounded window of at most 50 candidates was considered. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative LPA/local-plan-boundary reference, local-authority code, local-plan reference, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, title identifier, or equivalent selector binding any candidate boundary to this slot. Selecting one would invent partition ownership. Therefore no coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
